items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire tears, which with Tech X become a lingering (~1s) laser ring at a fixed offset ≈0.15–0.2 room-units in the firing direction at the player's row. Rocks block ring from hitting targets behind them. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse, radius ~2 tiles). Q and Space do nothing — don't retry. Diagonal moves stall against rocks; single-axis moves also stall when a rock's hitbox extends past its sprite. Reposition vertically (back off and approach from another lane) to free lateral moves. Hatch/trapdoor warps need near-exact x-centering and a sustained walk started ~0.1–0.2 units from the frame; standing ON the frame blocks the warp (step off, re-center, retry; sometimes several attempts). HUD layout confirmed as coins, bombs, keys (bomb pickup raised count 01; key-shaped sprite pickup did not raise keys, so keys stay 00 and earlier 'keyhole' tests with 01 were bombs, not keys).

BOMBS: bomb placed at feet then leaving the room via a hatch still detonated and cleared a rock ring — useful safe pattern. Same trick retested this run on torch-room chest ring: worked.

TECH X: acquired from the two-poop room pedestal this run (goggles persist). Ring killed a transformed green hopper/blob at ~0.15 units but a heart was lost in the exchange — it is a ranged tool, not a safe one. Ring destroys poop piles in ~2 hits; chest/rock-ring interaction: ring alone did NOT open the ringed gray chest earlier, but the bomb-cleared ring then contact-open worked (gave a bomb pickup and a red heart). Plain tears/contact also open plain gray chests.

PICKUPS: hearts need overlap (+1 heart). Coins need near-exact overlap; some gold specks never register. Bomb pickups auto-collect on overlap. A green gem-like blob/gem appeared in the rock field near the upper area; approaching/overlapping it coincided with a heart loss and a green glowing blob appearing — treat as a TRAP or damaging entity, effect still uncertain.

POOP PILES: two-poop room piles destroy but fully regenerate on re-entry (drops only 1 coin total). Grinding them is unproductive. Torch-room pile also seen to regenerate.

MAP / ROUTES (confirmed): Tutorial top trapezoid x~0.50 ↔ rock field (both ways). Tutorial bottom trapezoid x~0.49–0.50 ↔ torch room. Tutorial right doorway y~0.47 ↔ dark chest room (avoid). Torch room: top alcove x~0.50 ↔ tutorial (approach from ~0.1 below, centered); clear left lane x~0.31–0.42; center-lower rock cluster blocks direct descent — route up to y~0.33, right along top to x~0.66, down the right lane (watch bottom-right torch), then left along the bottom to the gold trapdoor x~0.50 ↔ two-poop room (enter from ~0.1 above, centered). Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown hatch x~0.50 (approach from ~0.1 below). Rock field top exit → TNT room. TNT room: barrels line the left wall; gray chests wedged ~y0.30 and ~y0.63; red-lidded brown barrel near the lower one. Beyond TNT: pink-enemy rock room (pink fat enemies, poop pile with blue flies).

HAZARDS: rock field is a damaging spawner/transit room — hoppers teleport to doorways, self-ring with spiky rocks, transform into a winged/spread form and a large green blob that damages fast; white-faced blobs also appear at bottom. Stay 2+ tiles clear, avoid center/upper-right, leave early. Corner torches damage on contact. Dark chest room (black spiders/blobs, chasers) is a heart-draining dead end — avoid. Death = empty grey heart outlines + bloodied sprite.

GOALS: recover hearts (health was low — 2 hearts at last check — hearts are priority), obtain keys (never obtained), open red-lidded chests (no key yet), test the rock-field keyhole door (~0.19,0.44) only with a confirmed key.

UNRESOLVED: what opens the golden keyhole door; whether keys exist/where; whether red-lidded containers need keys; green gem effect (possibly a trap); whether the Tech X pill respawns; meaning of the white slit mark on a fired-at chest; whether lasers can open a chest through a rock ring (evidence: no); exact coin pickup tolerance.
